attributes.action: Better funding and resource provisions for SEND students
attributes.additional_details: I am advocating for better finance and resource provisions for SEND students and families. Thousands of students currently face so many problems with the present system. I implore the authorities to do the needful and improve policies and reforms to help these people. Additionally resource provisions in mainstream schools should also be improved. Please sign my petition if you want to create a genuine change!
attributes.background: I would like the government to improve the current resource provisions for SEND students and families. Many students and families in the UK still face many issues regarding EHCP delays, finance shortages and systematic failures. Better strategies are required for creating a helpful change.

rejection.details:
